workouts.title: Week overview
workouts.description:
Welcome to the new chapter of our Fitness Phase. We hope everyone had a great holiday and now you are ready to turn it up a notch. 
This cycle of the phase will be even more focused on preparing for The Open and Quarter Finals! You will notice volume tapering down while intensity dials up in a 60/40 split.
Have fun and good luck!
